none: PAS NLM-6AD8B1: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Probably a Copy Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Reverse description: Probably fallen horseman; only the horse is discernible. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this worn coin. Diameter: 13.8mm, Weight: 1.33gms, die axis: possibly 9
